components.name: Desktop or Mobile Client
components.purpose: Uploads content and tracks a per-device change cursor.

components.name: Authorization Service
components.purpose: Checks ownership, sharing grants and revocation versions.

components.name: Metadata Service
components.purpose: Owns file versions, folders, manifests and durable change records.

components.name: Metadata Database
components.purpose: Stores versioned metadata, grants and ordered tenant changes.

components.name: Upload Service
components.purpose: Manages resumable sessions and content checksums.

components.name: Object Storage
components.purpose: Stores durable file chunks and committed manifests.

components.name: Change Queue
components.purpose: Buffers change notifications and background cleanup work.

components.name: Sync Notification Service
components.purpose: Sends change hints; devices recover from the durable change log.

components.name: Metadata Cache
components.purpose: Caches authorized metadata with bounded permission-aware lifetimes.

components.name: CDN
components.purpose: Serves authorized downloads from object storage with bounded signed URLs.

tradeoffs.guidance: Prevent lost updates; eventual notification does not imply eventual authorization.

alternatives: Push hints plus durable cursor replay
Periodic polling of a durable change log

tradeoffs.guidance: Do not infer global content equality across private tenants.

dataModel.notes: Index parent folder for cursor listings.
Commit only after content is durable; retain conflict versions.
Check on every metadata action and content-link issuance.
Persist deletion tombstones and per-device replay cursors.

flows.name: Upload publication
steps: Authorize and create an upload session with part checksums
Client uploads or resumes missing chunks directly to object storage
Verify the manifest and content durability
Conditionally publish the file version and change record
Notify devices, which replay authoritative changes

flows.name: Download
steps: Check the grant and current version in metadata
Client downloads from authorized CDN or object storage and verifies integrity
